acceptance_signals: A matching human-admitted task and create-only task-start baseline exist before implementation writes.
The resolved alignment journey mcpj-7f437c4bba4a45689835b0600fc68074 selects the identity-bridge direction.
The worker creates one read-only mapping only after Base64 decoding and both raw and encoded identity checks pass.
The mapping contains exactly source_length, source_sha256, encoded_length, and encoded_sha256 from the validated worker request.
Dry and actual execution receive identical identity values alongside the existing ARTIFACT_REPLAY_MODE value.
Caller-supplied source and the parent request cannot provide, replace, or mutate the identity context.
An attempted source mutation fails closed without changing the context, retrying, or reaching actual mode after a dry deviation.
Reports and representations still exclude source text, host paths, raw output, traceback, environment, credentials, and process details.
Fixture tests cover exact mapping values, immutability, dry and actual parity, mutation rejection, malformed identity rejection, and existing no-retry behavior.
Tests use only harmless local fixture source and mocks and never call the real caller, readiness probe, driver, action, build, evidence writer, cleanup, or network.

Existing dirty-worktree content outside the exact included paths remains byte-identical; pre-task shared-file content and prior baselines are preserved apart from bounded additions and the new baseline.
Focused, related, documentation and full supported tests plus task, repository, scope, JSON, privacy, zero-root, whitespace and diff checks pass.
No real artifact replay, dependency installation, external Agent or model, Git mutation, commit, push, publication, release, deployment, or broader journey occurs.

decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-44c21a236d2a435ba59afdf769013963 and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control.

requirement.summary: Extend the dependency-free internal artifact replay harness worker with one immutable source-identity context derived only from the already validated parent payload. Dry and actual source execution must receive the same mapping of raw and Base64 byte lengths and SHA-256 identities alongside the existing mode global, so a future separately admitted replay can bind its readiness request to the exact harness-prepared source. Add harmless fixture coverage only; do not execute any real artifact capability.

items: Exposing mutable identity data would allow source-side drift; the mapping must be read-only and derived only after strict validation.
Adding caller-controlled identity fields to the parent request would defeat binding and is prohibited.
The harness remains source execution containment rather than a security sandbox.
Shared documentation and harness files already contain admitted prior work and must preserve their pre-task content outside bounded additions.
A real replay is not authorized by this bridge task.
Reviewed assumption: types.MappingProxyType provides a sufficient stdlib read-only mapping boundary for normalized scalar identity values.
Reviewed assumption: The worker is the correct owner because it already validates the payload identities before compiling or executing source.
Reviewed assumption: A future source can construct the existing readiness request directly from this context without another harness change.
Reviewed unknown: Whether a future real replay reveals another integration deviation after identity binding.
Reviewed unknown: Cross-platform behavior, hostile-source containment, adoption, time savings, causal benefit and return on investment remain unproven.

title: Bounded artifact replay identity bridge v1
